text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the decisive battle, the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: *Inhale*... *Exhale*...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. Even though I've gotten 
consistently good at running with my 
emotions completely unleashed, this will 
be the first time I use it in an actual 
race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: However, fear not. I am quite fine.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I believe in everyone I've fought against 
up until now.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Trainer-dono supports me as well.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I have no fear!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
All that is left for me is to see the 
consequences of my choice through to the 
end!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yaeno Muteki, moving out!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Ooh, here she comes! It's Yaeno Muteki!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Aren't you looking extra sharp today? So 
cool!!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Ossu!!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, Yaeno! You've got a great look in 
your eyes today!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well now... if you let your guard down, 
you just might get burned, you know~.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Yaeno's burning red-hot today! Gaaah! Now 
I'm getting fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
—How long have I yearned for this day... 
Just like you, shining like a blazing 
light, I too shall radiate brilliance once 
more.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I can't stand just watching after all! 
I want to stand out there right now...!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Something about you has changed 
yet again.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, in order to beat you. In order for us 
to become the "Big Three."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I see... But I will not lose!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
It wouldn't do to have it any other way. 
Let us go to our decisive battlefield!
